"""Backtracking-priority regular-expression engine."""

class Match:
    def __init__(self, captures, num_groups):
        # captures: list of (start, end) or None, indexed 0..num_groups
        self._captures = captures
        self._num_groups = num_groups
    
    def span(self, n=0):
        if not isinstance(n, int) or n < 0 or n > self._num_groups:
            raise IndexError("no such group")
        c = self._captures[n]
        if c is None:
            return (-1, -1)
        return c
    
    def start(self, n=0):
        if not isinstance(n, int) or n < 0 or n > self._num_groups:
            raise IndexError("no such group")
        c = self._captures[n]
        if c is None:
            return -1
        return c[0]
    
    def end(self, n=0):
        if not isinstance(n, int) or n < 0 or n > self._num_groups:
            raise IndexError("no such group")
        c = self._captures[n]
        if c is None:
            return -1
        return c[1]
    
    def group(self, n=0):
        if not isinstance(n, int) or n < 0 or n > self._num_groups:
            raise IndexError("no such group")
        c = self._captures[n]
        if c is None:
            return None
        return self._str[c[0]:c[1]]
    
    def groups(self):
        return tuple(self.group(i) for i in range(1, self._num_groups + 1))
